newsitem.title: UK: Harvey Nichols current sales up 16 pct.
newsitem.headline: Harvey Nichols current sales up 16 pct.

text.p: Upmarket department store Harvey Nichols Plc said on Thursday sales in its main store in London's Knightsbridge were up 16 percent in the first nine weeks of its current half year.

The Hong Kong-controlled company, which made its debut on the London stock market earlier this year, said its Oxo Tower restaurant on the south bank of the Thames and its new store in Leeds had been performing better than anticipated.

The retailer said it had started work on extending its new lower ground floor at Knightsbridge, which is due to open in March next year, and will add about 4,000 square feet to the menswear department. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
